title: Canonical closed finite counit transport data
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $i:Z	o X$ be a closed immersion of schemes and $j:U	o X$ a quasi-compact open immersion whose topological image is complementary to that of $i$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work with the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant $A$-module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $
u_T$ for the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] and $N_T=
u_T^*$ for its exact derived pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Let $F=Ri_!^{\mathrm{et},(1,i)}$ be the etale compact-support candidate at the identity/proper compactification [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Define $\kappa:F\xrightarrow\sim Ri_*^{\mathrm{et}}$ by the identity-extension-by-zero comparison and the left unitor. Define $	au:Ri_*^{\mathrm{et}}\xrightarrow\sim D(i_*^{\mathrm{et}})$ by the exact-functor derived identification. Put $I=D(i_*^{\mathrm{proet}})$, the termwise descent of closed direct image, with exactness supplied by the complement, and define $\lambda:N_XRi_*^{\mathrm{et}}\xrightarrow\sim I N_Z$ by $N_X	au$ followed by the termwise descent of the canonical underived direct-image/comparison-pullback square. The underived pro-etale direct image is the sectionwise functor of [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image].

Let $G=F^{\mathrm{right}}$ with its chosen compact-support adjunction. Write $H=G R
u_{X,*}$ and $Ri_A^!=N_ZH$, the finite exceptional composite of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Transport the adjunction $F\dashv G$ along $\kappa$ and denote its counit $Ri_*^{\mathrm{et}}G	o1$ by $\varepsilon^{\mathrm{et}}$. For $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ define the transported counit to be the composite
$$I(Ri_A^!K)\xrightarrow{\lambda^{-1}_{HK}}N_X(Ri_*^{\mathrm{et}}HK)\xrightarrow{N_X(\varepsilon^{\mathrm{et}}_{R
u_{X,*}K})}N_XR
u_{X,*}K\xrightarrow{\varepsilon^
u_K}K.$$
Here $\varepsilon^
u$ is the actual comparison-adjunction counit. These are specified constructions of $\kappa,	au,I,\lambda$ and the transported counit, without an assertion of an ambient pro-etale exceptional adjunction.
